column1: # Exploratory hypotheses for the Sunplus SPHE8600 bring-up. Each line: ADDR VALUE [MASK] # why. NONE of these is observed hardware.
0xBFFE0018 0x0000001f   # clock multiplier: 8005b2b0 returns ((reg & 0x3f)+1) * 6,750,000 Hz. 0x1f -> 216 MHz (bracket 0x1b -> 189 MHz)
0xBFFE1448 or 0x00002000   # handshake: 8007da0c sets bit12 (start) then 8007da10 polls bit13 until 1 (done). Hypothesis: done reads 1.
0xBFFE0B08 clear 0x00000080   # thermal sensor: 80060078 writes the command, 8006007c polls bit7 until it clears (busy). Hypothesis: conversion completes at once.
0xBFFE0434 or 0x00000800   # 8005ac1c polls bit11 after each ~6.4M-instruction delay (up to 0x79 tries, dumping registers each time). Hypothesis: ready/lock bit reads 1.
